Apple TV has published the first trailer of Snoopy’s next adventure, where he finds his doghouse after it is accidentally sold at a yard sale. Watch it below.

Snoopy’s next adventure gets first trailer

Apple TV shared today the trailer for ‘Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy,’ which is set to premiere on July 31.

The new special is part of Apple’s long-running partnership with Peanuts, which has made Apple TV the exclusive streaming home for several Peanuts original series and specials, as well as the entire classic Peanuts library. Apple’s partnership with Peanuts has also expanded beyond streaming, bringing Snoopy to the Apple Watch through a dedicated watch face and to Apple TV through animated screen savers.

Here’s what to expect from ‘Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy,’ according to Apple TV:

Apple says the special also features a voice cast that includes Riley Vargas, Terry McGurrin, Rob Tinkler, Kitai O’Garro, Josephine Nisbett, Grace Nicolaou-Wood, Jo-Hannah Atchison, Lexi Perri, Athan Giazitzidis, and Diego Whalen, as well as an original song by Allen Stone titled “Home, Where Your Heart Found Me.”

Watch the trailer for ‘Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy’ below:

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month or part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
